weapons.name: Suppressor Ion
weapons.desc: Rebuff riot gear for starships. Two ion bolts that keep shields down.

weapons.name: Enforcer Laser
weapons.desc: A heavy patrol laser. One big hit, often.

sectors.name: Occupied Space
sectors.blurb: The Rebuff hold these systems with checkpoints and patrols. The resistance holds out in the gaps.
intro: Rebuff banners on every station. Keep your transponder quiet.
Occupied Space. The resistance is out here somewhere, and so are the patrols hunting them.

events.text: "Rebuff patrol to unidentified vessel. Cut your engines and prepare for inspection."

success.text: A bored officer walks right past the data you are carrying and waves you on.

fail.text: "Well, well. What's this?" They found it.

effect.text: Your sensors spoof a Rebuff supply code. The patrol salutes and moves on.

events.text: A Rebuff checkpoint blocks the route ahead: two gun platforms and a queue of nervous freighters.

success.text: The guards are underpaid and overworked. You slip through.

fail.text: Your face matches a poster. Sirens.

effect.text: You drift past the platforms like a ghost and pick up a dropped cargo pod on the way.
"Never saw you." He even tells you where the next patrol is going.

events.text: A Rebuff escape pod pings you on a private channel. "I'm done with them. Take me with you and I'll tell you everything I know."

effect.text: The deserter joins your crew. The Rebuff will be looking for them, though.

choices.text: Take the information, leave the pod.

effect.text: They give you patrol routes, and you give them a tow to a neutral beacon.

choices.text: Hand them back to the Rebuff for the reward.

effect.text: The reward is generous. Your crew don't speak to you for a while.

events.text: A Rebuff prison barge drifts at the beacon, its holds full of Fedoration sympathisers on their way to a labour camp.

effect.text: The barge's guards fight to hold their cargo.

afterWin.text: The prisoners are free. Two of them insist on joining your crew.

success.text: The doors spring open and the prisoners take the barge for themselves. They send you a share of the armoury.

effect.text: You jump away. It doesn't feel good.

events.text: Every channel is playing a Rebuff broadcast: a smiling admiral promising that resistance is pointless and the Fedoration is finished.

effect.text: You replace the admiral with a looping cartoon of him falling down the stairs. Rebuff morale suffers.

events.text: A battered freighter flashes a Fedoration resistance code. "We've got supplies, and a target. Want either?"

effect.text: Fuel and missiles, packed with care.
The target is a Rebuff patrol. It sees you coming.

afterWin.text: The resistance shares the spoils, including a piece of kit they took from a Rebuff depot.

choices.text: Give them scrap for the cause (20 scrap).

effect.text: They promise to slow the fleet down for you. They are as good as their word.
